Root cause: in the `sample_rise` mode-select logic, the `default` case (mode 3, CPOL=1/CPHA=1) incorrectly set `sample_rise = 0`, but per the spec's mode table, mode 3 samples `miso` on the rising (trailing) edge, so it needed `sample_rise = 1`. This caused mode 3 to sample/shift on the wrong edges. Fixed by setting that case to `1'b1`.
